Game Overview

At its heart, Wolfoo Supermarket Sort is a match-3 game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Wolfoo Supermarket Sort is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Wolfoo Supermarket Sort?

Wolfoo Supermarket Sort is a free match-3 game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Wolfoo Supermarket Sort free to play?

Yes, Wolfoo Supermarket Sort is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
